verdict.rationale: Puzzle's help center has a 'Creating custom rules' article in its transaction-categorization collection, and the startup page says tasks are 'described once, done automatically'. Together these suggest user-defined automation, but the pack only shows that article's title and gives no detail on triggers, conditions, or actions. Missing for 10: documentation of what events trigger rules (e.g. new transaction imported), what actions rules can perform beyond categorization, rule configuration details, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final
